oliver: quick ask - need the morning off next Tue for a medical appointment. our team has a scheduled deploy that afternoon. can i swap in a floating holiday or do i need manager + people-ops approval because of the release? cc @ryan
mina: submit the portal request and choose half-day. if the date falls in a blackout window we require manager + people-ops signoff. what's the exact date?
oliver: it's 2026-05-12. i think release blackout is 05/12-05/14 per sprint calendar.
ryan: confirm blackout. typically we allow half-days during blackout if a coverage owner is nominated and the work impact is minimal. need me to own the deploy morning?
oliver: that would help - thanks. i'd pick floating holiday to avoid eating carryover (i have 2 carryover days). does half-day consume 0.5 of float?
mina: yes, partial-day prorated (0.5). submit as floating and tag @ryan as coverage. i'll queue the people-ops approval once manager approves.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: time-off edits must be final 48 hours before payroll cutover. See HR portal: https://hr.redwood.com/timeoff
ryan: approved in portal, i'll own morning deploy checklist. @mina go ahead for people-ops signoff.
mina: signed off. marked as "exempt during sprint blackout with coverage". payroll will record floating -0.5. enjoy appointment :)
oliver: appreciate the quick turnaround, everyone.
